深圳水貝：英國YouTuber Barrett 在2026年6月走訪水貝，一條20克金條當日報價18,640元人民幣。
水貝是全中國最大的黃金珠寶交易中心，中國各地的金舖大多從這裡進貨；金價按當日國際金價計，沒有固定價。
片中數字均為影片所說，2026年6月當日價。
Shenzhen, Shuibei: UK YouTuber Barrett visited Shuibei in June 2026, when a 20 g gold bar was quoted at 18,640 yuan for the day. Shuibei is the largest gold and jewellery trading hub in China, where most of the country's jewellery stores buy; gold is priced off the day's international price, nothing fixed. Figures as spoken, June 2026 prices.
Video: Barrett, YouTube, 20 June 2026.
